name: Pyrum Innovations AG
summary: Pyrum Innovations AG is a company specializing in the global development, construction, and management of facilities dedicated to recycling discarded tires. From these used tires, the firm extracts and produces a range of valuable secondary raw materials, such as rubber granules, recovered carbon black, specialized thermolysis oils, and steel wires. Pyrum Innovations AG was established in 2008 and operates from its headquarters in Dillingen, Germany.
